//: Type checking only: nothing is compiled, and the browser runs exactly the files you edit.
Types are expressed as JSDoc in the source and in js/types.js, so the project stays plain
JavaScript with no build step while still catching renamed fields, bad shapes and dead code.
strictNullChecks is deliberately off. Turning it on reports 426 problems, of which 281 are
the game state before a run begins and canvas contexts that are never actually null. Fixing
those means hundreds of non-null assertions that add no safety. The one real hazard it did
find, an unplaceable staircase, has been fixed properly with a fallback instead.
